rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent mass across the four views, with a compact non-rectangular footprint and a modestly bent/capped upper form. It is not over-fragmented and the parcel containment appears respected. The main weakness is the public threshold: the blue access edge is acknowledged only weakly, with no clear court, undercut, or entry seam carving the ground plane. That said, for a neighborhood-living brief the mass still plausibly supports a compact mixed-use/ground-active building better than a pure object or a wrong typology. The silhouette is coherent enough to pass as an early-stage massing diagram, but it would benefit from a stronger carved void and more explicit street-facing opening in the next iteration.
